title: Find a Hobby
coreMove: Keep one low-stakes craft outside work, money, and applause; stillness grows when your hands can make something without needing the result to prove you.

exampleSpecs.audience: a cultural director reviewing a failed staff renewal night
exampleSpecs.stakes: a restorative practice turned into another performance review
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Open after the failed event and locate the single misstep that made the hobby perform for status

exampleSpecs.audience: a facilitator teaching creative practice without turning it into performance
exampleSpecs.stakes: grief and attention being flattened into approval metrics
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The protagonist notices his own status mistake mid-stream and changes the center of the session

exampleSpecs.audience: a studio lead setting rules for a weekly clay practice
exampleSpecs.stakes: the team turning renewal into content for clients
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A written memo carries the scene and sets a boundary around one unpaid practice

exampleSpecs.audience: adults choosing how to hold a creative hobby
exampleSpecs.stakes: the same art form either restoring attention or feeding comparison
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Two named people meet the same songwriting prompt with opposite approaches and divergent outcomes

exampleSpecs.audience: a high-responsibility leader who treats play as selfish
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A peer reframes the stuck view in one quotable sentence

exampleSpecs.audience: a learner confused by a no-posting class rule
exampleSpecs.stakes: understanding why low-stakes making restores more than public proof
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: A learning context uses the learner's confusion as the material
